entry.title: Watermark-Aware Memory Reclaim for MicroVM Sandboxes
entry.summary: MicroVM sandboxes hide guest memory from the host, so host-side reclaim often evicts the wrong pages. We present a two-level watermark controller that combines host PSI with guest free page reporting. On a 64-core server, it reduces p99 allocation latency by 23% and improves the memory overcommit ratio by 1.4x compared with memory.high alone.

entry.title: PSI-Guided Memory Offloading for Container Clusters
entry.summary: Memory utilization is a poor signal for offloading because page cache inflates usage. We use PSI lost-work to decide how much anonymous memory to offload to zswap. In a 200-node cluster, total memory drops by 27% with no p99 regression.

entry.title: A Survey of Federated Learning for Wireless Edge Networks
entry.summary: Federated learning allows edge devices to train models without sharing raw data. This survey reviews privacy, communication cost, and wireless scheduling challenges in edge networks.

entry.title: CXL Tiering with Page Hotness Tracking
entry.summary: Tiered memory needs cheap hotness tracking to place pages between DRAM and CXL. We describe a sampled access-bit scheme and a demotion policy that reserves headroom for new allocations. The prototype improves throughput by 18% over NUMA balancing on a 4-socket machine.
